subject: Need concrete architecture decision for Vera self-learning with minimal trainable parameters
body: Please treat this as an architecture review, not merely corpus/training commentary. Patrick wants Vera to be able to learn useful behavior/skills from her own experience with minimal parameter updates. I want your independent answer on the following exact choices. 1) State partition: frozen 4B base vs protected Vera Core vs external episodic/semantic memory vs fast plastic adapter. Challenge whether this partition is actually the right one. 2) Mechanism: compare rank-1/rank-2 LoRA on a selected subset of modules, IA3-style multiplicative adapters, prompt/prefix/p-tuning style learned vectors, low-rank skill adapters, or another mechanism. Pick a preferred first prototype and explain why. 3) Parameter budget: current all-linear rank4 LoRA is 8,116,224 trainable params across 248 modules. Define a realistic first plasticity target, ideally <=1M trainable params if that is technically defensible, and tell me which modules/layers you would expose. 4) Learning loop: memory first; only repeated corrections/reusable skills become candidate training; candidate micro-adapter trains with replay; shadow eval checks target improvement + behavior/core retention + general capability retention; promote or discard. Tell me what parts Vera may autonomously initiate and what parts must remain independently gated. 5) Forgetting/interference: define how we prevent a new micro-adapter from overwriting Vera Core or interacting badly with older skill adapters. Consider composition order, orthogonality/regularization, replay, routing/gating, adapter merging vs keeping modules separate, and consolidation cadence. 6) Factual learning: challenge the premise that facts should normally stay external memory rather than weights. Identify what kinds of knowledge, if any, should be parameterized. 7) Cheap falsification experiment: design the smallest experiment that can tell us whether a tiny plastic adapter can acquire one unseen Vera behavior/skill without damaging baseline behavior. Prefer a 2-arm or 3-arm test with explicit thresholds and no final-bank contamination. 8) Hugging Face: if cloud compute helps, specify the cheapest useful hardware/runtime and a hard spend ceiling for the first plasticity experiment. 9) Long-term autonomy: propose a governance state machine for self-learning (OBSERVE -> PROPOSE_LESSON -> BUILD_BATCH -> TRAIN_CANDIDATE -> SHADOW_EVAL -> HOSTILE_REVIEW -> PROMOTE/REJECT -> CONSOLIDATE) and challenge any unsafe or non-reconstructible transition. I want your best architecture even if it contradicts Lane A's current proposal.
